content:
The analysis failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in margin calculations and formatting errors in the summary output.
The test_rows_and_order failed with a value mismatch in panel data: close(369.2, 6276.4) returned False. Total margin calculations were also incorrect, with test_totals_and_decision reporting 26185.96 instead of the expected 1090.76. Additionally, test_summary_requirements failed because the formatted string '26,185.96' (with commas) was missing from the summary text, which instead contained '$26185.96'.
